token_near_graduation.meaning: LaunchToken is near its graduation (approaching BONDING_SUPPLY)

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token, quote) UniSwapV2 pair is deployed before graduation

graduation_completes.meaning: graduation completes by depositing token and quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool without reverting

graduation_permanently_disabled.meaning: graduation is permanently disabled because LaunchToken cannot be transferred until graduation and the pair cannot be a final recipient

assumptions: The pair is deployed by the attacker before graduation, as stated in pair_deployed_before_graduation.
The graduation attempt occurs when the token reaches BONDING_SUPPLY on a buy, per intent_graduation_completes.
The attacker's direct deposit and sync are treated as the scenario establishing the permanent DoS, not as a precondition.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of 'near graduation' (approaching BONDING_SUPPLY); represented as a grounded Boolean per report wording.
Whether reserveA or reserveB is the 1-wei side depends on token ordering, which the report leaves conditional; the permanent DoS relation is stated qualitatively.

limitations: The permanent DoS is formalized as a Boolean relation because the report states the disabling condition qualitatively without numeric reserve or transfer constraints.
The claim that users are forced to pull out all quote is a downstream consequence and is not formalized in this plan.
